headline: Largest transport tender in Czechia has a winner. Czech Railways succeeded - Novinky
summary: Czech Railways will operate suburban trains in Prague and the Central Bohemian Region from 2030. The 30-year contract is priced at 165.17 billion crowns, the largest carrier tender in Czechia.
why: Czech Railways is the state-owned national rail operator, and a contract of this size shapes its long-term revenue and transport-service spending.
